text:
alex: Evening shift here — quick async brief for this handoff.
alex: Current incidents: 1) embed-cache-throttle (P2) — higher 95th latency on /v1/embeds reads; 2) model-fallbacks (info) — a few automatic fallbacks to m-small-q across ap-north.
oncall-bot: INC-4723 created for embed-cache-throttle — assigned to alex — https://incidents.redwood/inc/4723 :rotating_light:
alex: What I did: kicked a targeted cache-pop job for top-50 prefixes, scaled redis read replicas +1, and turned on prefix read-through for test-tenants.
priya: Observed metrics: 95th latency dropped from ~420ms -> ~260ms after the cache-pop; error rate still ~0.6% (mostly 500s from model-fallback path).
marcus: Quick check: any evidence of KV key expiry storms? could be TTLs misaligned after the deploy yesterday.
alex: Good call — I grepped logs and saw a burst of GET miss patterns around 03:11 UTC tied to a config push. TTLs look fine but a small race caused bulk re-pop traffic.
sarah: Blockers: need approval to increase replica autoscale headroom for next 4 hours (we're seeing sustained 2x baseline traffic).
marcus: I can approve. PR #4827 updates HPA headroom, it's small change — merging after a quick review.
priya: Mitigations planned: 1) merge HPA tweak, 2) add short-term cache priming job (already running), 3) add alert on sustained miss-rate >3% for 15m.
alex: Quick commands if you need to check status:
```
# cache-pop job
kubectl -n infra logs job/cache-pop-embed-1678
# redis replica pods
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=redis | grep replica
# query error rate
curl -s "https://metrics.api/query?m=embed_miss_rate&range=15m"
```
oncall-bot: Alert suppressed: embed-cache-throttle throttle alert muted for 30m by alex :mute:
marcus: Small note — related PR to reduce prefix churn is in review (PR 4832). If we merge it, long-term miss spikes should reduce.
sarah: Next steps for next shift: monitor INC-4723, keep alerting unmuted after HPA merge, and follow up with infra to schedule a config rollback if we see another TTL flood.
alex: I'm handing over — I'm reachable on thread for 30m, then offline. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
sarah: Ack, thanks alex. I'll take the next watch. :thumbsup:
priya: Thanks — leaving notes in the incident doc with timing and commands.
marcus: LGTM, will watch logs for any regressions.
oncall-bot: Shift note recorded: alex -> sarah (1912340001 -> 1912340299)
